projection.purpose: Coordinate catalogue, licensing and verified distribution without conflating their states.

contract.input: A source-pinned release, verified private package, authoritative commerce events and a site identity.
contract.step: Import only approved release bytes with their integrity digest.
Expose the catalogue through the operational API; keep payment and entitlement authority with WooCommerce.
Require explicit administrator connection and valid entitlement before package delivery.
Reconcile cancellation through the operational projection and sheet export.
contract.invariant: Release existence, purchase state, distribution entitlement and local installation are separate objects.
contract.reject: Refuse a new download after revocation without silently uninstalling local software.

test.given: A synthetic order enabled a verified add-on installation on a test site.
test.when: The commerce authority cancels the order and reconciliation completes.
test.then: Deny a new authorized download; preserve the installed plugin and record the cancellation projection.
